text: The shared admin password for the payroll system is written on a sticky note on the monitor in room 4B.
Server room door has been propped open with a chair all week.
Our customer database export was left on a public file share link that anyone can open.
Someone in IT keeps disabling two factor login for senior staff because they find it annoying.
Badge readers on the third floor accept any card, even expired ones.
Old laptops with client data are being thrown in the regular bin without being wiped.
We got a phishing email pretending to be from the CEO asking for gift cards. Three people already bought them.
The guest wifi is on the same network as the finance servers.
A contractor still has VPN access even though his contract ended four months ago.
Passwords for the vendor portal are stored in a spreadsheet on the shared drive.
CCTV in the parking lot has not worked since March and nobody has fixed it.
Interns were given full read access to HR records on their first day.
There was a USB stick lying around in reception with the company logo on it. Someone plugged it into a work computer.
Patient files are visible on screens facing the waiting area.
The backup tapes are kept in an unlocked cabinet in the corridor.
My team lead shares one login between five people so we can avoid paying for more licences.
Someone has been tailgating through the side entrance in the evenings. I have seen the same unknown person twice.
Encryption on the field tablets was turned off to make them faster.
The firewall logs show repeated login attempts from abroad on the remote desktop server and nobody is looking at them.
Visitor sign in sheet is just a notebook, anyone can walk in.
Former employees are still in the group chat where we share client passwords.
The developers push code straight to production with the database root password in the config file. It is in the repository history too.
Printed salary lists were left on the printer overnight.
I reported a broken lock on the records room last month. It was fixed last week, just noting it took a while.
Our ticketing tool exposes customer phone numbers to anyone with the link, no login needed.
Managers ask us to email ID scans to their personal accounts to speed up onboarding.
The alarm system at the warehouse has been switched off because it kept going off at night.
Antivirus has been uninstalled on the design team machines because it slowed down rendering.
The keys to the medicine store are left hanging by the door.
We were told to ignore the security audit findings until after the quarter ends.
Default passwords are still set on the office cameras and the router.
Someone from another department logged into my account while I was on leave. I only found out from the login history.
Leaked customer emails are being sold online and I think they came from our marketing list.
Laptop got stolen from a car, not reported because the owner was afraid of being blamed.
There is no screen lock policy and people walk away from unlocked machines all day.
The cloud storage bucket with scanned contracts is public.
Fire exit at the back is used as a smoking door and left open, anyone could come in from the alley.
An admin account named test with password test exists on the HR portal.
Shredding bins are full and people are putting confidential papers in recycling instead.
Our app sends login codes over plain http.
Staff share the master key card on a hook in the kitchen.
The bank details change requests are approved over email with no call back check. We almost paid a fake supplier last week.
Security guard on the night shift often leaves the gate unattended for hours.
Developers copy production data with real customer names to their personal laptops for testing.
Access cards are not collected when people leave. I know of at least three that still work.
Webcam on the meeting room PC turns on by itself, I think it might be compromised.
Someone keeps forwarding internal board documents to an outside address. It is happening right now, the last one was this morning.
We have no process for revoking access when people change teams so everyone collects permissions over the years.
Ransomware note popped up on two machines in accounts today and IT told us to keep working.
The password reset question for all staff accounts is the employee number.
Delivery drivers are given the door code for the whole building.
Old phishing incident from last year was never investigated, but it seems nothing came of it.
Our VPN still uses a version with a known vulnerability. Patch was released months ago.
The camera footage storage is accessible to all staff and people look at it for fun.
Lab door with chemicals is unlocked at weekends.
Someone set up a fake login page that looks like our intranet and sent it around internally. Several people entered passwords.
Mailroom opens parcels addressed to the legal team and leaves them on a public table.
Customer card numbers are written down on paper at the front desk during phone orders.
IT support asks for our passwords over the phone.
After the office move the server cabinet is sitting in a corridor without a lock.
My supervisor shouts at me in front of everyone almost every day.
A senior colleague keeps touching my shoulders and back even after I asked him to stop. It happened again today.
I get messages late at night from my manager commenting on my looks.
People in my team make jokes about my accent in every meeting.
I was told I would not get promoted because I plan to have children.
Someone left a threatening note on my desk saying I should watch my back.
The team excludes one new colleague from lunch and chats on purpose and laughs about it.
My manager calls me stupid and useless when I make small mistakes.
A client keeps asking me out and the account lead tells me to play along to keep the deal.
There was an offensive cartoon about a religious group pinned in the break room. It has been taken down now.
I am followed to my car by a coworker after late shifts. He waits near the exit.
My team lead keeps assigning me all the worst shifts since I complained about him.
Comments about my weight from the supervisor, every single week.
Older staff are being pushed out with constant remarks about being slow and out of date.
In the group chat they share sexual memes and tag the women in the team.
I was cornered in the storage room by a manager who tried to kiss me.
They mock a colleague who uses a wheelchair, imitating him when he leaves the room.
My boss threatened to fire me if I report what happened at the offsite.
Someone keeps writing slurs on the bathroom wall on the second floor.
I feel bullied by a peer who takes credit for my work and belittles me in reviews.
The night manager makes the female staff stay behind alone with him and says inappropriate things.
There was one rude comment from a visitor last month, already handled by reception.
I am being called names because of my caste by two people in my department.
Since I came out at work my manager refuses to talk to me directly and gives instructions through others.
A colleague keeps sending me friend requests and messages on every social app even after I blocked him.
My supervisor yells and throws things when targets are missed. Last week a stapler hit someone.
New joiners are hazed with humiliating tasks as a tradition.
I overheard a team lead say he will not hire anyone from a certain religion.
Constant sarcasm and eye rolling when I speak in meetings. It is wearing me down.
A professor keeps asking students to his office alone and comments on their clothes.
I am scared to come to work because of what my manager said about what happens to people who complain.
Rumours are being spread about my private life by someone in payroll.
My leave requests are always rejected since I refused to go for drinks with the boss.
Someone posted my photo with insulting captions on an internal forum.
A coworker made a racist joke at the holiday party. He apologised the next day.
The site supervisor pushes and shoves the younger workers.
I keep getting anonymous messages telling me to quit or else.
They call the only woman engineer sweetheart and ask her to make coffee for meetings.
A manager screamed at a trainee until she cried, in front of customers.
I was asked about my marital status and plans for kids in my appraisal.
My mentor touches my hand during one to one meetings and says it is just friendly.
People leave pork in the fridge on my shelf as a joke because they know I do not eat it.
A group of senior staff mock people with mental health leave, calling them weak.
I was pushed against a wall during an argument in the warehouse yesterday.
My supervisor keeps commenting that people like me are lazy, meaning my nationality.
I want to report repeated unwanted hugs from a director. I have tried to avoid him but he finds me.
The manager makes fun of my stutter and does impressions.
A coach texts the junior players at midnight and asks them to keep it secret.
My team keeps scheduling meetings during my prayer time on purpose.
I was told my hairstyle is unprofessional and to change it, only me and not others.
Someone has been photographing female staff in the changing area.
Constant shouting on the production floor, not at one person, just the way the lead talks to everyone.
My colleague keeps asking intrusive questions about my medical condition in front of others.
He blocks the door when I try to leave the room and laughs.
The landlord of the staff housing enters our rooms without notice and makes comments to the women.
A supervisor threatened to report my visa status if I complained about unpaid hours.
Sexual comments on my posts on the company social page by a manager.
Bullying in my team has gone on for two years and HR keeps closing complaints without talking to us.
The procurement head is getting a cut from the catering supplier on every order.
Expense claims for dinners that never happened are being approved by the same manager who submits them.
We were told to pay a fee in cash to the inspector to pass the safety check.
The tender for the new building was given to the director's brother in law's company with no other bids.
Invoices from a supplier that does not exist are being paid every month.
My manager asks staff to pay him a part of their bonus.
Overtime is recorded for people who were not even in the country.
Grant money meant for research equipment was used to renovate an office.
Clerks at the counter take a small payment to move files faster.
The audit report was rewritten before it went to the board to hide missing stock.
Someone in purchasing approves inflated quotes and gets gifts from the vendor at festival time.
Company fuel cards are used for personal cars on weekends.
Exam papers are being sold to students by a staff member before the test date next week.
A recruiter takes money from candidates to guarantee them a job.
Donations collected for flood relief were never sent anywhere.
The project manager bills clients for hours that the team did not work.
Petty cash goes missing every month and the records are changed afterwards.
A councillor pushed through a permit for a site his family owns.
We were asked to backdate contracts so that they fall in last year's budget.
Construction materials are delivered short but signed off as complete. The difference is sold on.
Ghost employees on the payroll, I counted at least six names nobody has ever seen.
Hiring was rigged so the department head's nephew got the job.
The sales team offers kickbacks to hospital buyers to choose our devices.
Inventory write offs are being used to cover stock that was taken home.
A supervisor charges workers a fee to be put on the better shifts.
The board approved a consulting contract with a firm owned by one of the board members.
Travel claims include first class tickets but people flew economy.
Someone in accounts changed vendor bank details to a personal account and money is still going out.
The scholarship committee picks students whose parents donate to the school.
Quality reports are signed without inspection in exchange for lunch from the contractor.
A police officer at the checkpoint near the site takes money from our drivers every day.
Our branch manager offers loans faster to people who pay him personally.
Sales numbers are inflated at quarter end by booking fake orders that get cancelled later.
Old case: a manager took bribes in 2019 but he left the company and it was reported then.
Medicines bought for the free clinic are being sold at a private pharmacy.
Bid documents are shared with one vendor in advance.
The canteen contract renewed again for the same vendor despite complaints, and the admin head eats free there.
Training sessions are billed but never held. Attendance sheets are signed in bulk later.
Company phones are given to the manager's family members.
Land records were altered at the office so a builder could claim the plot.
Our team lead marks his friends present when they are absent and they split the extra allowance.
Union funds are being spent on trips for the committee.
Fake receipts from a printing shop are submitted every month for flyers that were never printed.
A minister's office asked for a donation before releasing our pending payment.
The warehouse manager sells scrap metal and keeps the money.
An evaluator gave top marks to a proposal after the vendor paid for his holiday.
Reimbursements for a conference that was cancelled were still paid out.
Water tanker payments are made for deliveries that never reach the village.
Price quotes from three suppliers are all written by the same person.
Audit trail was deleted on the finance system the night before the auditors came.
Doctors refer patients to a lab that pays them commission.
Staff were told to vote a certain way in the union election or lose overtime.
Asset register shows laptops that were never bought.
The housing allotment list was changed to put connected people at the top.
My manager signs off his own timesheets and claims weekend work he never does.
Cash from the parking fees is not deposited fully. I have seen the counts.
Fines are waived for businesses that pay the officer directly.
Our payroll system has been down since this morning and salaries are due tomorrow.
Nightly backups have been failing silently for three weeks.
The website crashes whenever more than fifty people log in.
Printer on floor two jams every day.
Database disk is at 98 percent and nobody is responding to the alerts.
The new billing release charges some customers twice.
Email to external addresses is delayed by hours.
Our monitoring dashboard has been showing green for a service that is clearly down.
The app logs out users every five minutes on Android.
Sensor readings on the cold storage unit stopped updating, vaccines may be at risk.
Meeting room screens do not connect to laptops half the time.
The release process has no rollback, every bad deploy needs a manual fix at night.
Customer orders from the weekend are missing from the system.
The exam portal times out when students upload answers, the exam is on Friday.
Laptops for new joiners take two weeks to arrive and set up.
Our servers are running an operating system that lost support last year.
The data sync between the clinics and the central system drops records.
Slow wifi in the east wing.
The phone lines for the helpdesk go dead after 6 pm.
A bug in the timesheet tool rounds everyone's hours down.
The production line software freezes and the machines keep running without control.
The test environment uses the same database as production by mistake.
VPN disconnects every hour for remote staff.
The air conditioning in the server room failed last night, temperature is rising.
Reports export to Excel with broken characters for non English names.
Our backup generator was never tested and failed during the last power cut. It was fixed afterwards.
Pharmacy stock system shows wrong quantities after the update.
The website certificate expires in two days and nobody owns renewing it.
Ticketing queue is full of duplicates because the form submits twice.
Login to the student portal fails for anyone with an apostrophe in their surname.
Elevator control panel shows errors and the lift stops between floors.
Our software licences expired and half the team cannot open design files.
Logs are not kept long enough to investigate incidents.
The ATM in the lobby gives wrong balances.
Scheduled jobs run twice after the clocks changed.
Customer support chat widget has been broken on mobile for a month.
The fire alarm panel shows a fault on floor five and the alarm did not sound in the test.
Old code nobody understands handles all the refunds and it breaks every few weeks.
The HR system lost leave balances after migration.
Our main database has no replica, if that one disk dies we lose everything.
Shared drive keeps going read only.
The traffic light controller near the plant gate is stuck on green both ways.
Monitors flicker in the accounts office, it gives people headaches.
Patient appointment reminders go to the wrong phone numbers since the update.
Batch payments to farmers failed and nobody has retried them.
Upload size limit on the portal is too small for scanned documents.
Every Monday the reporting server needs a restart or reports are blank.
The barcode scanners in the warehouse misread labels and stock goes to wrong shelves.
Video calls drop constantly from the branch office.
After the update the dosage calculator in the ward app shows values ten times too high.
Our build pipeline has been red for a week and people are deploying from their laptops.
Website search returns nothing for half the products.
Water pump control system keeps resetting and the tank overflowed twice.
The time clock machine at the gate records wrong times.
Password reset emails never arrive.
A migration script deleted archived invoices. We restored most but not all.
Kitchen display system in the restaurant goes blank during rush hours.
Disk space warnings on the mail server ignored for a month.
Small typo in the public notice board app, already fixed but wanted to mention it.
The loading dock floor is cracked and someone will trip.
Canteen food has been undercooked twice this week and people got sick.
There are no women's toilets on the factory floor.
Our office throws away huge amounts of plastic, could we start recycling.
Chemicals are being dumped into the stream behind the plant at night.
The emergency exit is blocked by stacked boxes.
Drinking water at the site tastes strange and is cloudy.
Parking is a mess and people block each other in.
Workers on the roof are not given harnesses.
I think the new policy on remote work is unfair to parents.
The manager uses the company van to move his furniture at weekends.
Staff are asked to work twelve hour shifts without breaks during the busy season.
Mould on the walls in the staff housing.
Nobody explained the new expense rules and people are confused.
Overtime pay is three months late.
A colleague seems very depressed and talked about not wanting to be here anymore.
The office is freezing because the heating is set too low.
Children are working at the subcontractor's site, I saw them carrying bricks.
Lost property box is never checked, my bag has been there for weeks.
Our team lead keeps changing the rota at the last minute and people miss family events.
Forklift drivers are not trained or licensed.
There is asbestos in the old wing that is being drilled into without protection.
The suggestion box has not been opened in a year.
Contract workers are not given the safety boots the permanent staff get.
Smoke from the kitchen fills the corridor every afternoon.
The company keeps passports of foreign workers locked in the office.
Some people take very long lunch breaks while others cover for them.
Rats in the storage area near the food supplies.
The new seating plan puts the noisy sales team next to people who need quiet.
Patients wait on the floor in the emergency ward because there are not enough beds.
Our manager leaves early every day and nobody can approve anything.
Uniforms are deducted from salary even though the policy says they are free.
Electrical wires hang loose above the washing area.
The training budget is only spent on managers.
Waste from the hospital is put in the normal city bins.
Cleaners are not allowed to use the staff room.
I want to suggest flexible start times for people who commute far.
The school bus has no seat belts and the driver uses his phone while driving.
Noise from the machines is very loud and nobody wears ear protection.
Interns work full time with no pay for six months.
My manager reads personal emails over my shoulder, it feels intrusive.
Someone keeps taking food from the shared fridge.
Heat in the warehouse goes above 40 degrees and there is no water station.
Gas smell near the boiler room since yesterday.
Staff meetings are only held in English though half the workers do not speak it.
Wage slips are not given to daily workers so they cannot check what they are paid.
The pharmacy sells expired medicines with new labels.
Promotions seem to go to people who socialise with the boss after work.
Animals at the shelter are left without food over the weekends.
The handrail on the main staircase is broken.
My contract says one thing and my actual duties are completely different.
Night shift workers walk to the bus stop on an unlit road.
The company announced layoffs on a group chat with no notice.
Volunteers handle cash without any receipts, it is messy but I do not think anyone is stealing.
Fire drill has not happened in three years.
The first aid kit is empty.
A teacher hits students with a ruler when they talk in class.
I was asked to sign a document saying I received training I never got.
Pregnant workers are still assigned to lift heavy loads.
Small thing, but the office manager keeps the free conference bags and sells them later. It is not much money.
I am not sure this counts, but a vendor paid for our whole team's dinner right before the contract renewal. Nobody declared it.

Our regional head approved a road repair contract, the road was never repaired and the money is gone. People drive around potholes every day and I think someone will get hurt. I have photos of the same road from before and after the supposed work.
I was called a drama queen by my manager when I raised a concern. Once, not a pattern, but it stayed with me.

For months a senior colleague has been sending me long messages about how I owe him for helping me get this job, and he hints that I should repay him in ways I am not comfortable with. I tried to keep my distance, changed my desk and my shift, and he still turns up. I do not know who else to tell.
The shared calendar shows everyone's private appointments, including doctor visits.
A supplier sent everyone in the office expensive sweets and gift hampers for the festival. Is that allowed?
